content.text: Edit @Video 1 into a coherent cinematic live-action-style fan scene. Use the reference video's visible performance, positions, support, object possession, camera direction and timing as semantic guidance, not as a guarantee of identical frames. Replace only the blond, nape-tied girl riding beside the glasses-wearing lead with Carina Malfoy, an approximately fifteen-year-old Slytherin student: fair skin, youthful narrow face, pale platinum hair tied at the nape, a cute, pretty appearance and a small proud smile. Replace the coarse dark-haired boy with Harry Potter, an approximately fifteen-year-old Gryffindor student: youthful face, tousled black hair, round dark glasses and a small forehead scar. Keep their white collars, grey V-neck knitwear, black school robes and black school shoes; Carina has a green-and-silver tie and green robe lining, Harry a red-and-gold tie and red lining. Their lower robe panels stay secured at the waist for safe riding. Carina's pleated skirt retains an opaque riding underlayer; Harry wears charcoal trousers. Keep the same two lead identities throughout. Twelve anonymous school players, including short pale-haired field players, retain their own identities and coarse silhouettes on their own brooms where visible. Keep their faces distinct from both leads. Keep a sunlit pale-blue sky, open green lawn, simple pale hoop goals and sparse surroundings, with consistent soft daylight. Do not add spectators, buildings, rescue equipment, a wand rescue, a kiss or a victory. Preserve one uncaught gold winged Snitch, one red Quaffle, two dark Bludgers, fourteen brooms, four Beater bats and six hoop goals; never duplicate a consequential object. Maintain the exact stable tandem state inherited from the rescue, Harry behind Carina on the same supported broom. Over these7 seconds, Harry looks toward the small uncaught gold glint above the distant goals, then toward Carina's shoulder. His English line is "You almost had it." Carina briefly glances toward the glint, faces forward and shifts her steering hand to leave him a little more room. Her guarded English reply is "Then don't fall next time." Harry's shoulders ease. Hold the two steady silhouettes sharing one broom and end cleanly at black. The Keeper stays outside the closing frame; the old broom and uncaught Snitch continue away. Add no catch, scoreboard, confession, kiss or second ending. Retain the two exact lines for the final local soundtrack; this planned visual edit requests no generated audio.
